notes.title: Update 1 is LIVE!
notes.content:
With this first update, we went ahead and fixed some minor bugs that had been discovered since launch. We've also gone ahead and created a new bundle where you can get the game AND the OST and save 15% when you buy them together! Take the sounds of GloGo with you everywhere, even when you can't play the game! 

More updates coming soon, please post any bugs, comments, or suggestions to our community page!

-Wyktin

notes.title: Spring 2018 GloGo price update!
notes.content:
With the start of Daylight Saving Time and everyone 'springing forward' we decided that it was time of us to update our price too!  You can now get GloGo for the new Spring price of $9.99!  If you've been waiting to pick up a copy, get yours now and join the others who have already been playing!

Please be sure to join the community and let us know your thoughts, comments, and what you'd like to see come to the game. 

-Wyktin
